hero.title: We are PublicidadActiva
hero.subtitle: Creative and Design Agency
hero.description: A comprehensive graphic design and content strategy agency dedicated to emotionally connecting brands with their audience. At PublicidadActiva, we don't just design; we narrate visually captivating stories that build lasting relationships and loyalty.

uxResearch.title: UX Research
uxResearch.description: We dive deep into your users' needs and behaviors to optimize the interface and experience of your digital solutions, ensuring intuitive and satisfying navigation.

brandIdentity.title: Brand Identity
brandIdentity.description: We build and renew your visual identity to effectively communicate the values and essence of your brand, creating a lasting impact on your audience.

webDevelopment.title: Web Development
webDevelopment.description: We develop attractive and functional websites that reflect the quality and professionalism of your brand, ensuring an optimal user experience.

businessStrategy.title: Business Strategy
businessStrategy.description: We offer strategic consulting to align your business objectives with design and content, driving growth and innovation in your business.

webDesign.title: Web Design
webDesign.description: We create web designs that not only look spectacular but are also effective, improving user interaction and increasing conversions.

photography.title: Photography
photography.description: We capture the essence of your products and services with high-quality photographs that enhance and complement your brand identity across all platforms.

ideas.title: Generating new Ideas. Solving challenges.
ideas.description: At PublicidadActiva, we stand out for our ability to transform complex challenges into creative and effective solutions. Our dedication to innovation and excellence has driven the continued success of our clients.

whyDifferent.title: WHY ARE WE DIFFERENT?
whyDifferent.description: At PublicidadActiva, we believe that design goes beyond aesthetics. Each project is an opportunity to create a unique emotional connection, transforming ideas into visual experiences that communicate and captivate.

points.stories: Visual stories that connect: Every design we create tells a story, meticulously crafted to resonate with your audience.
points.strategies: Personalized strategies: We understand that every brand is unique. Our design solutions are customized to perfectly align with your objectives.
points.results: Results you can see: More than just design, we provide measurable results that drive growth and brand loyalty.

latestDesigns.title: OUR LATEST DESIGNS
latestDesigns.description: At PublicidadActiva, every project is an opportunity to innovate and demonstrate our commitment to excellence. Take a look at some of our most recent projects and discover how we help brands shine:

skills.description: At PublicidadActiva, we transform our passion for design into visual solutions that capture and communicate the essence of your brand. Here's how we make it possible:
skills.branding: Branding: We create memorable brand identities that resonate with your target audience and stand the test of time.
skills.interfaces: Interface Design: We design clean, intuitive, and efficient interfaces that improve user interaction and overall functionality.
skills.webDev: Web Development: We build websites that not only look good but also function flawlessly, optimized for all devices and browsers.

home.fusion: At PublicidadActiva, we fuse art and strategy to bring to life visual projects that not only attract but also connect emotionally with your audience.

awarded.title: Award-winning design by PublicidadActiva
awarded.description: At PublicidadActiva, our commitment to excellence has led us to obtain numerous recognitions in the world of design. Our approach focuses on fusing aesthetics and functionality to create visual solutions that not only capture attention but also tell stories and build solid brands.
awarded.product: Product Design: Our product designs are not only visually appealing but also functional and adapted to current market needs.
awarded.branding: Brand Identity: We develop brand identities that reflect the essence of your company, ensuring that each element conveys your vision and values consistently.
